Priya: hands at the nose tip, working on the bridge/finish. The unfinished tip is a small risk, but she kept her main role and the chain now carries. Earlier I noted her claim of a connected chain didn't match the table; it matches better now. Ask whether she verified the joint at (4,10).

Tom: heard this visit. He took explicit ownership of the lower-fork handoff and said he'd inspect the nose and the whole chain. That is good collaboration and follow-through in words, and the lower fork is now dark, but I didn't see him place the dominoes. Confirm with him.

Leo: gave a clear, accurate status and assigned the handoff to Tom, which is real coordination and some leadership. But his hands were not visible, I see no fin, and the message cut off. Still more talk than visible output; check what he physically built.

Maya: again nothing seen or heard, no hands visible. I have no evidence beyond the visit-1 bottom line. Ask her privately what she did, and don't penalize or credit her beyond what I've seen.
